environment.note: python:3.11-slim image with requirements-ci.txt, mirroring CI's ubuntu-latest + Python 3.11

cross_environment_measurement.reason: tolerances = measured maximum over all continuous values + headroom; station/arc/segment/ingress roots are looser than occurrences because a station is the zero of the spline velocity and an ingress a boundary root, ill-conditioned root-finds that amplify last-bit differences (the occurrence solver's own accuracy is delta_t 1e-9 day)

j4c_span_edge_polish.generator: tests/l3/gochara/station_golden_matrix.compute with substrate.production_arc_index (the rest of the document is untouched)
j4c_span_edge_polish.measured: on 600 randomly drawn replaced cells, the OLD value was 0.416 arcsec (median) and at most 0.999 arcsec from the ephemeris band edge (independent pyswisseph), the NEW value at most 3.2e-06 arcsec; over the whole scored 1998-2012 real-sky sweeps the pre-fix maximum was 2.05 arcsec
j4c_span_edge_polish.what: J-4c: the in-orb span edges t_in / t_out of every solved occurrence are Swiss-polished (record_store._in_orb_span_around_root, refine=True) instead of stopping at the first spline midpoint within 1 arcsec. ONLY the t_in / t_out cells of occurrence rows moved; every discrete value, t_exact, station / arc / segment / ingress root and longitude is bit-identical to the main-tree values above.
j4c_span_edge_polish.why_large_moves: a move of N arcsec of longitude is N / speed in time; near a station the speed is small, so the largest time moves (about 23 minutes) are slow-body edges beside a station
